about_the_game:
Immerse yourself in the dreamy atmosphere of Blue Bride with this exclusive Soundtrack DLC.

This pack includes 5 original theme songs and 2 in-game ambient tracks, all in high-quality MP3 format. Whether you're reliving emotional moments or just enjoying the serene melodies, this soundtrack brings the soul of Blue Bride directly to your ears.
